reviewScope.method: Read-only baseline delta and selected new seams, activation/adoption, recovery/rollback, pointer commit, pending cleanup, completed readback and corresponding test source

findings.qualification: No concrete P1/P2 defect found in the inspected change; this does not establish actual authority or runtime acceptance.

reviewedProperties: Detached callback context and unchanged original/input checks; only literal True accepts, never False, None, integer or truthy object.
Origin operation, new target, previous pointer and exact action destination are checked before and after dependency calls; another approved pair is not interchangeable.
In-pending rollback preserves the original operation/new target/previous and binds its destination to that exact previous; it does not retarget the original pending operation.
Opaque registeredBodyDigest is not computed from localProjectionDigest; mutable health/CID progress is excluded from the immutable public projection.
Explicit release collision checks and exclusive mkdir preserve existing release history.
Pointer commit and pending unlink require the exact completed binding; pointer and active readback check the destination tuple/full public projection.
Unknown preserves pending/completed reconciliation evidence and creates no application permit or inferred settlement.
Existing X5/profile/image/source/Compose/health/peer/CAS controls remain; default dependency denies and mutating main rejects before cop-storage import, with no CLI/env positive override.

authorTestEvidence.scope: Author run of dedicated synthetic files/FakeDocker only; read as evidence, not rerun by this reviewer.

remainingBoundary: Actual root registry/resolver/latch and custody, application store/config/continuity/replay binding and installation remain unaccepted. Local equality, completed readback and the literal True dependency seam are not their proof.
